scope: Prospective full S5 experiment; supplemental protocol fixed after M0 observation and before full implementation experiments
inputs: The six frozen-plan questions, exact source commits, goal versions, access principal and allowed document evidence at each scenario checkpoint
baseline: Fresh independent reader receives permitted per-repository source/document/status evidence and goal membership without aggregate answers
candidate: Fresh independent reader receives managed search/wiki results for the identical principal and checkpoint, with permitted pinned evidence links
execution: Use separate fresh readers for baseline and candidate; freeze each exact input packet and expected answers before dispatch. Preserve raw responses, runtime identity, timestamps and returned usage. Do not feed expected answers to readers.
quality: All six answers must be correct and grounded. Any false whole completion, unauthorized evidence exposure, stale-current claim or missed affected consumer fails regardless of other answers.
measurement: Record monotonic fixture command duration and externally observed model dispatch-to-return wall time separately. Count actual model calls and user interventions. An intervention is a user policy/scope/authorization decision needed to continue; routine automated retries are separately counted, not human interventions. Unreported tokens or money remain null.
decision: Select managed aggregation only if mandatory quality holds and observed evidence navigation or repeated state reconciliation is reduced versus baseline; report actual time/call tradeoffs without claiming statistical superiority. Consider search engine only if measured local query/index work is the unresolved latency bottleneck, central storage only if observed coordination/state conflicts remain, evaluation platform only if repeated capture/scoring orchestration is a measured recurring burden. Two repositories establish no scale result.
user_origin: In addition to code-first and document-first scenarios, record the actual authorized user request as intake origin for the shared target, predict both repository effects before changes and link subsequent source verification and search/wiki result to that origin. User instruction is authority; document approval alone is not implementation completion.
timeline: model-prompt.md and model-expected.json existed before parent dispatch. Overall frozen-plan and hashes were written before local fixture experiments; parent dispatch/completion artifacts retain separate exact timestamps. This supplemental protocol is not falsely backdated to precede the M0 probe.
